mainEntity.name: What kind of compensation can be sought in a birth injury case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compensation in a birth injury case aims to cover the extensive damages resulting from the injury. This can include past and future medical expenses, such as surgeries, therapies, medications, and specialized equipment. It also covers lost earning potential for the child, pain and suffering, and the emotional distress experienced by the family. In some cases, compensation may also include funds for home modifications, specialized care, and other long-term needs to ensure the child's quality of life and ongoing support.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compensation can cover extensive damages, including past and future medical expenses, lost earning potential, pain and suffering, and costs for specialized care and equipment.
